records.public_claim_text: Clinical Trial/Study Report (CSR) A documented description of a trial of any investigational product conducted in human participants, in which the clinical and statistical description, presentations and analyses are fully integrated into a single report (see ICH E3 Structure and Content of Clinical Study Reports).
